input: Swap out the shower head for a rainfall one

gold.taskTitle: Replace existing shower head with rainfall one
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to remove their current shower head and install a new rainfall-style shower head in its place.

questions.title: Have you already bought the rainfall shower head?
questions.description: Clarifies whether the user needs to source and purchase the new shower head first or if it is already on hand and ready to install.

questions.title: What is the current pipe fitting type and size?
questions.description: Determines the existing pipe connection type (e.g., standard half-inch NPT) to ensure the new shower head will be compatible without extra adapters.

questions.title: Is the shower arm wall-mounted or ceiling-mounted?
questions.description: Identifies where the water supply pipe exits, as a ceiling-mounted arm may require a different installation approach than a standard wall-mounted one.

questions.title: Do you want a fixed head or one on an adjustable arm?
questions.description: Establishes whether the user wants the rainfall head mounted straight overhead on an extension arm or fixed directly to the existing shower arm.

questions.title: Are you comfortable doing this yourself or need a plumber?
questions.description: Determines whether the plan should be a DIY step-by-step guide or focused on hiring and briefing a professional plumber.

questions.title: What tools do you currently have available at home?
questions.description: Identifies whether the user has basic plumbing tools such as an adjustable wrench, plumber's tape, and a cloth to protect finishes.

questions.title: Is there a specific finish you need it to match?
questions.description: Clarifies whether the new rainfall head must match existing bathroom fixtures in a particular finish such as chrome, matte black, or brushed nickel.
